# verify_station_network { #wass2s.verify_station_network }

```python
verify_station_network(df_filtered, extent, map_name='Rain-gauge network')
```

Plot station locations on a map to verify the station network.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type             | Description                                                                               | Default                |
|-------------|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| df_filtered | pandas.DataFrame | DataFrame containing station data with 'STATION' column ('LAT', 'LON') and station names. | _required_             |
| extent      | list             | Geographic extent in the format [west, east, south, north].                               | _required_             |
| map_name    | str              | Title of the map (default is 'Rain-gauge network').                                       | `'Rain-gauge network'` |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Stations are plotted as red markers with labels, using Cartopy for map features.
